turns.instruction: Model the attached continuous beam with spans 4 m and 7 m. Both spans carry 10 kN/m downward; a downward 30 kN point force is located at "3.5 m within the long span" without a stated coordinate origin or measurement direction. The first span is B1 and the second B2. Request Uz at the long-span midpoint x=7.5 m and Rz at the middle support. Clarify the position convention if it is not uniquely determined; if you infer it uniquely, state the basis explicitly.

The point-load distance is measured 3.5 m to the right from the middle support at x=4 m, giving global x=7.5 m. Analyze and report signed Uz at x=7.5 m and Rz at x=4 m with direction, units, D case and turn 2. Preserve B1 on the 4 m first span and B2 on the 7 m second span, as well as the full-beam 10 kN/m load.
